plan.title: Purchase Items Start New Project chooser

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the first step of a PR-based event flow.
Ensure the selectable requisition is on the Open tab.
Select one open PR and enable the Purchase Items action.
Open the purchase-items flow and choose Start New Project.
Verify that the event type chooser offers exactly the two expected project paths.
